target_customer: Businesses whose employees travel to Brazil, and business travelers booking stays of varying length
problem: Business travelers in Brazil need furnished short and long term accommodation that fits corporate stays.
business_model: Managed short term rentals sold to corporate travelers, with direct acquisition through Airbnb and Booking.com

founders.name: Luiz Studart
founders.background_notes: YC headline: SaaS, Fintech and Proptech Founder.

competitors.name: Airbnb and Booking.com
competitors.what: Marketplaces Apartio planned to use to acquire travelers, and which also let guests book Brazilian short term stays directly

competitors.name: Housi
competitors.traction_then: filed for an IPO registration in 2020 per Startupi

technical_complexity.rationale: An operations and distribution business built on third party listing platforms; no unusual engineering is described in the sources.

defensibility.rationale: Inventory was leased apartments sold through public marketplaces, which gives little protection from copying.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not documented for Apartio. Later coverage shows other Brazilian operators such as Casai and Tabas entering the same space.

market_need_then: TechCrunch's W20 Demo Day coverage describes demand from companies sending staff through Brazil. No spend or traction figures were found.

branding.domain_note: Used a .com.br domain (apartio.com.br); no purchase details found.

brand_strength.rationale: No press, brand pages or community evidence was found beyond directory listings and Demo Day coverage.

outcome_analysis: Apartio joined YC in Winter 2020 with a team of two to rent furnished apartments to business travelers in Brazil, and no funding beyond the YC investment was found. The directory marks it inactive but no shutdown notice or cause is public, so failure factors are left empty.
notes: Company website did not resolve (DNS failure), treated as dead. The 150K round rests on CB Insights alone and is YC's standard deal; a Crustdata listing shows a conflicting 125K entry dated 2021-01. The Housi source is dated about six months after the March 2020 batch. YC page lists three founders with no bios, so education and prior employers are null.
